name: capture-observation
description: Append one observation, question, hypothesis, or concern to TASK_STATE.md as lean, append-only task memory, leaving other artifacts and work undisturbed. Use when something surfaces mid-work, a hypothesis needs logging, or a concern is too small for decision-interview or targeted-questions. Do not use for a decision (use decision-interview or sync-task-state), a new direction (use direction-adjust), multi-artifact changes (use state-reconcile), or with no task (run task-init).
